title: SWE-Pruner Pro: The Coder LLM Already Knows What to Prune
abstract: arXiv:2607.18213v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pruning long context for coding agents has been a vital technology for efficient context management. While existing context pruning methods such as SWE-Pruner realize this by attaching a separate code classifier, we find the agent itself encodes internal representations indicating the relevance of code context when reading tool output. Based on this finding, we propose SWE-Pruner Pro, which prunes tool outputs directly inside the agent. Concretely, a small head turns the agent's own internal representations into a keep-or-prune label for each line, with a length-aware embedding keyed to each tool output's line count. Across two open-weight backbones and four multi-turn benchmarks, SWE-Pruner Pro saves up to 39% of prompt and completion tokens while preserving task quality, with bounded inference overhead. Notably, on MiMo-V2-Flash SWE-Pruner Pro additionally raises the SWE-Bench Verified resolve rate by +3.8% and the long-context Ool

translated_title: SWE-Pruner Pro：代码大模型自身早已知道该剪枝什么
translated_abstract: 对编程智能体进行长上下文剪枝一直是实现高效上下文管理的一项关键技术。现有的上下文剪枝方法（如SWE-Pruner）通过附加一个独立的代码分类器来实现这一目标，而我们发现，智能体自身在读取工具输出时，其内部表示中已经编码了代码上下文的相关性信息。基于这一发现，我们提出了SWE-Pruner Pro，它直接在智能体内部对工具输出进行剪枝。具体而言，一个小型头网络将智能体自身的内部表示转化为每一行的“保留或剪枝”标签，并结合与每个工具输出行数相关联的长度感知嵌入。在两个开源权重骨干模型和四个多轮基准测试中，SWE-Pruner Pro在保持任务质量的同时，最多可节省39%的提示与补全token，且推理开销可控。值得注意的是，在MiMo-V2-Flash上，SWE-Pruner Pro还将SWE-Bench Verified的解决率额外提升了3.8%，并提升了长上下文Ool（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SWE-Pruner Pro利用代码智能体自身的内部表示直接在模型内部剪枝工具输出，无需外部分类器，最多可节省39%的token且不损失甚至提升任务性能。
en_tdlr: SWE-Pruner Pro leverages the coding agent's own internal representations to prune tool outputs directly within the agent, eliminating the need for an external classifier, saving up to 39% of tokens while preserving or even improving task performance.
